caption: The drawing depicts a toy train consisting of two connected parts: a locomotive and a tender. The locomotive is cylindrical and colored in a dark grayish-blue hue with faint yellowish horizontal lines, and it is fitted with two short, rounded smokestacks painted in red and gold along the top, as well as a large, black, hexagonal chimney at the front. The locomotive has three large wheels, each painted red with a central yellow star, and there is a small platform in the front featuring two smaller red wheels with yellow centers. The tender, attached behind the locomotive, is a rectangular wooden box with four red wheels that also have a yellow design in the center. The tender has a floral decoration with green leaves, blue and red petals painted on its side. The objects are rendered in a realistic style with muted shading, set against a beige background with a thin rectangular outline framing the composition.
title: Toy Locomotive
